sentence_verdicts.text: The introduction of Review Residuals in this work builds upon the principle that gating residual connections can lead to improved performance, as demonstrated by [bachlechner2021].
sentence_verdicts.best_evidence: We show that the simplest architecture change of gating each residual connection using a single zero-initialized parameter satisfies initial dynamical isometry and outperforms more complex approaches.

sentence_verdicts.text: By conditioning the gate on both the current state and the proposed update, Review Residuals offer a novel approach that differentiates itself from prior gated and scaled residuals, aligning with the human-factors principle of independent verification.

While [bachlechner2021] and [kimi2026] both explore gating mechanisms, their approaches differ: [bachlechner2021] uses a single zero-initialized parameter, whereas Review Residuals employ a learned, input-dependent gate.
sentence_verdicts.best_evidence: We propose Attention Residuals (AttnRes), which replaces this fixed accumulation with softmax attention over preceding layer outputs, allowing each layer to selectively aggregate earlier representations with learned, input-dependent weights.

sentence_verdicts.text: In contrast to [graves2016] and [banino2021], which focus on adaptive computation time and reasoning capabilities, respectively, Review Residuals aim to improve the reliability of updates in transformer architectures.
sentence_verdicts.best_evidence: ACT does not yield large gains in performance; however it does provide intriguing insight into the structure of the data, with more computation allocated to harder-to-predict transitions, such as spaces between words and ends of sentences.

sentence_verdicts.text: The gating mechanism in Review Residuals is designed to scale each update by a learned, input-dependent gate, which is a key distinction from the fixed coefficient of one used in traditional residual connections, as highlighted in [bachlechner2021].
sentence_verdicts.best_evidence: We show that the simplest architecture change of gating each residual connection using a single zero-initialized parameter satisfies initial dynamical isometry and outperforms more complex approaches.

sentence_verdicts.text: This approach is expected to provide more reliable updates, potentially leading to faster convergence and better test performance, as observed in [bachlechner2021] for Transformers.
sentence_verdicts.best_evidence: When applied to 12 layer Transformers, it converges 56% faster on enwiki8.
